description: List stock on hand per product — QtyOnHand, AllocatedQty, AvailableQty, OnPurchase, AvgCost — optionally for one warehouse or as at a past date. Unleashed: GET /StockOnHand/{page}.

asAtDate.description: Stock on hand as at this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

isAssembled.description: Include quantity that can be assembled via auto-assembly BOMs in AvailableQty.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

warehouseCode.description: Only stock in this warehouse code.

warehouseName.description: Only stock in this warehouse name.

name: unleashed_list_stock_on_hand
title: List stock on hand
